messages.subject: Re: how to interpret the results
parts:
Dear Kerim,

I think that the component guidance in Wallace and the references are a good start point to answer this question. Unfortunately, there is not a unique "recipe" to choose the best model. The best model depends on your data and the question that you want to resolve.

Also, the BITC youtube channel (https://www.youtube.com/user/rosaytown/featured) is a valuable resource in which you can find some videos of model evaluation.

Best,
Gonzalo
